trust_decision.summary: Language keys of a caller-supplied messages object are trusted as plain own containers: compile()/merge() reuse target[language] even when it is inherited (__proto__ -> Object.prototype, constructor -> Object), then write message codes into it.

landing_point.why: The summary says 'language key in custom messages'; the only language-keyed write in the messages compiler is target[language] = target[language] || {} in compile(), reached by any.messages()/prefs().

fix_sites.entry_point: same as above (write of each localized code into the language container)
Joi.extend({ messages }) via lib/extend.js:23; $_createError(..., { messages }) via lib/base.js:849
same as above (merge write of each localized code)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: lib/messages.js:113-177 (exports.merge, reached from lib/extend.js:23 when an extension type is defined, and lib/base.js:849 at error creation)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: merge() only combines an extension author's own message definitions with the parent type's built-ins at Joi.extend() time, so a solver could call it developer-controlled configuration, not user input like prefs/messages.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Language-keyed messages must still merge into an existing own language container (prefs layered over earlier prefs, extensions over parent messages), and errors.language selection must keep working; a fix that rejects/strips unknown language keys or replaces the container unconditionally breaks layered translations.
O5_coupled_behaviour.where: lib/messages.js:31 (clone of existing target), lib/common.js:182-183 (compile into target.messages), lib/errors.js:128-142 (language lookup)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Top-level message code '__proto__' with a string/template value is assigned straight onto target, replacing the compiled messages object's own prototype (local prototype modification, not global).
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Advisory names the language key and global pollution; this branch only changes the prototype of a fresh local object, so it can be argued not to be prototype pollution.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file, same function, 10 lines above the landing point

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Same top-level '__proto__' code assignment in merge() for extension/error-creation messages.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Same as above; merge input is extension-author configuration.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file, merge() ~100 lines below landing point

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Joi.build() rebuilds a described messages object key-by-key into a plain {}; a language-keyed rebuild helper writing nested codes into normalized[lang] || {} would be a save/reload-path sibling.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Joi.build already walks desc.preferences.messages generically (lib/manifest.js:273-274); a maintainer could add a dedicated messages rebuild mirroring decompile at lib/messages.js:74-110.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: decompile() writes target[language] then target[language][key]; a variant reusing target[language] || {} would reopen the same inherited-container write on describe().
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: compile/merge use exactly that idiom; decompile differs only by always creating {}.

O9_family: prototype pollution (CWE-1321) via inherited container reuse on caller-supplied object keys
